name: pf-sf-infographics
description: Generate Pathfinder 2e and Starfinder 2e class infographics (poster or booklet) as SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF.

scripts.build: bun run content:check && bun run --cwd packages/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/engine/test && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p packages/cli/test && tsc -p tools && bun run --cwd packages/web typecheck
